title: Review of c01's FCH uptake cargo: replicates on seed 7; S, I, D supported, W real but set by the imposed partition potential
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (T=400) and with chi=0 (WORLD_P, as the author's pack_chi0). Micelles form from noise and divide in synchronized waves (17 persistent splits, gen 3, 0 merges; the u dynamics are identical to c03's cargo world on the same seed). With c01's cargo_contrast.py 92-100% of bodies per frame hold the uniformly supplied solute at >= 2x the outside, aggregate rising 18x -> 165x over the run (not yet at steady state); chi=0 gives exactly 1.0x. The control is matched and decisive. As in my review of c03's cargo world, I mark W by construction: the contrast is the equilibrium Boltzmann partition of a solute with an imposed affinity chi u for amphiphile-rich regions, not containment behind a boundary.

observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png: fixed-size round bodies persisting between fission waves
observations.W: rerun_contrast.txt: 92-100% of bodies >= 2x per frame, aggregate 165x at t=400; rerun_chi0_contrast.txt: 1.0x in every frame

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed7 (chi=0, same seed, same bodies): contrast 1.0x

verdicts.limitation: W holds by construction: chi c grad u is an imposed drift of the solute toward amphiphile-rich regions, so any amphiphile body concentrates it up to the partition factor exp(|chi| delta u); a Laplacian twin trivially cannot. There is no boundary layer, and daughters refill by re-equilibration rather than inheriting contents (the author says so). Up to 8% of bodies per frame sit below 2x (newborn or nucleating). D is feed-driven and synchronized. Not checked: the 1.5x resolution arm.
